title: Maintenance Plan
description: CAT 100 textbook section connecting maintenance plan to AI critique log showing accepted, modified, and rejected suggestions, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Design a maintenance plan that is triggered (a concrete date or event), specific enough to verify, and matched to a static GitHub Pages platform.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use feedback, support requests, and revision notes to improve the maintenance plan before sharing it.
